LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Enabled_Tip: Turn off to restore the unmodified vanilla world map immediately. This setting adds no save data.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Background_Tip: Place a compact translucent nameplate behind each label.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_FontSize_Tip: Follows RimWorld's UI scale. Larger labels may hide sooner when the map is crowded.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Opacity_Tip: Controls the opacity of labels over the map. Lower values reveal more terrain in crowded regions. The setting applies to the nameplate and text together to preserve their contrast.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Rounded_Tip: Rounds the four corners of the dark nameplate. This only changes its appearance, not which names appear or where they are placed.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Outline_Tip: Outline label text for contrast over bright terrain.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Displaced: Keep labels that cannot fit under their icon
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Displaced_Tip: When two names collide, Faction Lens can move one farther down and draw a connector line to its icon. This is off by default. Without displacement, the mod hides any name that cannot fit directly beneath its icon.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_HoverOnly: Only show a name when pointed at
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_HoverOnly_Tip: Hides every added name until you point at a world object, then shows only that object's name in its relationship colour.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_PlayerPriority: Give your own colony names first claim
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_PlayerPriority_Tip: When names compete for space, place your colonies first so their names remain visible. Turn this off to give every name equal priority.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Legend_Tip: Draws a small key on the world map showing which colour corresponds to which relationship.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Other_Tip: Includes compatible modded world objects whose ownership is meaningful.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Settlements_Tip: Label permanent faction bases that you can trade with, visit by caravan, or be raided from.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Sites_Tip: Label temporary world locations such as quest sites, which disappear once they are resolved or expire.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Colorblind_Tip: Use an Okabe-Ito-derived palette with distinct luminance and hue.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Reset_Tip: Restores every Faction Lens setting, including label font size and all six relationship colours, to its default.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Color_Tip: Updates the preview immediately and applies to an open world map without reloading.
